What to do about it

View data tables

All data is synthetic, generated with Python (seed 78). Fraud patterns were built into the generator, so the findings show the analysis method and not real UPI behaviour.

Fraud rate is fraud cases divided by transactions. Money lost is the amount of fraud transactions that completed. Amounts are in Indian rupees; L is lakh and Cr is crore.
